chapters.title: Carglass company background and business context
Migration drivers - scalability and cloud adoption
Business challenges with coordination and bookings
Business Central improvements to booking workflows
Data migration and integration as key success factors
Results - performance gains and customer satisfaction impact

features.name: Automated technician scheduling with booking system
features.description: Customers can view suggested next available time slots at the closest branch and technicians are automatically reserved when bookings are placed.

features.name: Real-time booking visibility across branches
features.description: Booking information is instantly available in a unified overview, providing visibility across multiple branches and improving coordination.

features.name: Cloud-based Business Central ERP
features.description: Migration from on-premises ERP solution to cloud-based Business Central to meet scalability, data access, and collaboration requirements.
caveats: migration of data from on-premises is required

features.name: Enhanced booking system performance
features.description: Booking site and booking board functionality runs faster in the cloud with real-time data access compared to the previous on-premises system.

features.name: Data integration and smart connectivity
features.description: Connecting and making data smart through integration is identified as the key game changer beyond just migrating data from on-premises to cloud.

quotes.text: We needed a system that could keep up with our ambitions in terms of scalability, data access and collaboration.
quotes.why_it_matters: Articulates the core business requirements driving the migration decision.

quotes.text: We have over a hundred of repair shops across Sweden or branches as we like to call them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the scale and complexity of the organization requiring cloud-based coordination.

quotes.text: customers have suggested the next available time slot for the closest branch and a technician is automatically reserved when the booking is placed
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the automated workflow improvement achieved with Business Central.

quotes.text: The information is then instantly available in the dimeuler overview and this is a huge improvement compared to the previous way of working.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the real-time visibility benefit delivered by cloud migration.

quotes.text: Connecting data and making it smart, it's the actual game changer.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights that integration and data connectivity are critical beyond just migration.

quotes.text: The booking site and the booking board runs much faster and we get access to data in real time.
quotes.why_it_matters: Quantifies the performance and access improvements from cloud-based Business Central.
